checks.name: Source matching covers pinned Japanese independently of reviewed Chinese availability
Whitespace projection preserves digit boundaries, width, case, punctuation and original offsets
Literal escaped brackets and backslashes are not dynamic slots
Clear-window boundaries never create adjacent-line matches
Scrolling can retrieve both neighboring windows while preserving source offsets
Partial-word prefixes are diagnostic hints and never resolve complete sources
Unknown glyphs block lookup instead of using source text to fill characters
Arbitrary OCR substitutions are rejected and do not invoke fuzzy correction
Actual zero-distance font-3 alternatives find Heracross without rewriting raw OCR
All competing source records remain even when one matches exactly
Game filters retain both candidates when the actual game is unknown
Explicit typed context distinguishes Ghost species and type without guessing from text
Opaque buffers preserve actual captured values and never claim semantic approval
Repeated slots must contain the same current value
Internal name spaces remain significant for repeated-slot identity
Ambiguous variable boundaries retain every viable capture interpretation
Current numeric values are captured afresh and never reused between calls
Bare slots, adjacent opaque buffers and unsupported functions cannot consume arbitrary input
Trainer class/name source templates remain candidates alongside generic link templates
A player or explicit battle name cannot absorb an observed prose line
Trainer classes use full source terms and do not split at an internal の
Finite class evidence respects target game and missing terms fail closed
Unreviewed multiline buffers and genuine multiple splits remain hypotheses
Experience messages no longer match the reviewed gift-item or starter-species buffers
Source-scoped gift constraints retain actual item/species values and their provenance
A buffer type is never inferred globally from its number or suffix wording
Typed Intimidate grammar resolves the ability/name boundary without choosing a generic buffer split
Rendering functions are explicit retrieval hypotheses, never wildcard variables
Observed overlapping windows narrow source identities within the same session only
Forged previous candidate IDs cannot invent observed continuity
Menu segmentation follows detected layout, while dialogue remains an intact window
Inventory quantity, display number and selection marker are preserved as separate visible fields
Price parsing is confined to shop rows and does not discard digits from ordinary text
Removed inventory fields cannot introduce character alternatives into the item name
Inventory and shop interface actions are not excluded by the item-name filter
Battle menu options retain their combined source record and explicit grid coordinates
Run retains normal and Safari menu candidates without complete-menu context, and prose is not indexed as cells
Short anchored PC-name and send-out templates are retrieved without admitting bare buffers
Digit notation projection finds the actual source while keeping leading zeroes and raw OCR
Adjacent player-name and finite honorific slots retain separate complete captures
Native summary titles are separately identified from hash-verified original assets
Ability panels separate the original title, complete name and multiline description
Move-panel PP values stay current and do not become part of move-name lookup
Summary stat, owner and experience fields preserve every current value
Ambiguous PC layout is split only with the full ordered source-backed menu sequence
Ribbon count overwrite is confined to its source and never turns every literal number into a slot
Block level, identity and blender composition retain visible values without inventing names
All decomposed fixed-set text has raw spans and no visible characters disappear
Matcher does not read answer files, review cases or screenshot identifiers
All actual OCR inputs and source-review judgments retain their bound evidence hashes
Review HTML keeps all 579 regions and has a syntactically valid offline filter
Binding boundary audit preserves its baseline and reproduces all named reviews
Repeated full evaluation is byte-for-byte reproducible

scope: source matcher behavior and reproducible diagnostics; not exhaustive source correctness or Chinese acceptance
